hand.title: Daily Hand

events.text: Your cards — 8, Q. Both players called a raise before the cards were dealt.
Turn — 3. Your opponent led out with a bet. You called.
River — King. Your opponent fired again — half the pot.

wrongReasons: A 2 has similar strength, but look at when the aggression shifted — the turn card connects with the correct hand in a way it doesn't connect with A 2.
Q 3 doesn't benefit from the turn card the way the correct hand does. A player holding only one pair wouldn't have the confidence to raise on that street.
A 3 doesn't benefit from the turn card the way the correct hand does. A player holding only one pair wouldn't have the confidence to raise on that street.
hand.explanation:
Answer: 6 7

Your opponent flopped a straight and immediately raised to build the pot. They led every remaining street — consistent value betting across all streets is a strong signal of a made hand.
